'''Hangar B''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]''.<ref name="Commando" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="ProsecutorDate">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' dates the [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster]] to a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the First Battle of Geonosis to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Thus, the mission must take place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] were sent on a [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|mission]] to rescue the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] after it had been [[Attack on the Prosecutor|attacked]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] working with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After a Separatist [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]] appeared in the system, the commandos were forced to hold of a group of [[droid dispenser]]s in Hangar B, while they figured out how to destroy the hangar's regulator.<ref name="Commando" />
